title: De-MA.ch: a Web-based Database for X-ray and Electron Microanalysts
content: Laboratory managers and users of electron probe microanalyzer (EPMA) or scanning or transmitted electron microscopes (SEM, TEM) require comprehensive and flexible documentation for their daily work to achieve high-quality qualitative or quantitative X-ray microanalyses. The Database of electron Microanalysis (De-MA.ch) [1,2] is an online tool that aims to provide lab-specific information on microanalytical reference materials (µRM) and analytical setups, characteristic X-ray data, and to manage reservation and training requests. An earlier version of this database, designed for a single laboratory, was presented at the 2013 M&M meeting [3]. This remodeled website currently accepts multiple laboratories with up to five instruments (SEM, EPMA, or other) each. It is designed for multi-user facilities from beginners to expert users. A responsive interface makes it usable on small screen (cellphone, tablet). Users will find these tools useful in developing and maintaining high quality, reproducible, and efficient analyses, whereas laboratory managers will be able to keep records of their microanalytical µRM database and analytical protocols.
